_about: Public-domain Edward Bickersteth (1786-1850, evangelical Anglican, secretary of the Church Missionary Society, Rector of Watton) for the Word Hoard: A Scripture Help (eighth edition, 1821), A Treatise on Prayer (fifteenth edition, 1839), A Treatise on the Lord's Supper (New York, 1849), The Christian Student (Boston, 1830), A Practical Guide to the Prophecies (ninth edition, 1852), The Promised Glory of the Church (1844) and A Treatise on Baptism (second edition, 1844), raw Internet Archive OCR. Not his son Edward Henry Bickersteth, Bishop of Exeter. Added 2026-10-03 by lane A, round 14 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.

bickersteth-scripture-help-1821: A Scripture Help, eighth edition (London: L. B. Seeley, 1821)
bickersteth-prayer-1839: A Treatise on Prayer, fifteenth edition (London: R. B. Seeley and W. Burnside, 1839)
bickersteth-lords-supper-1849: A Treatise on the Lord's Supper, ed. L. P. W. Balch, third New York from the ninth London edition (New York: Stanford & Swords, 1849)
bickersteth-christian-student-1830: The Christian Student, from the second London edition (Boston: Perkins & Marvin, 1830)
bickersteth-prophecies-1852: A Practical Guide to the Prophecies, ninth edition, enlarged (London: Seeleys, 1852)
bickersteth-promised-glory-1844: The Promised Glory of the Church of Christ (London: Seeley, Burnside, and Seeley, 1844)
bickersteth-baptism-1844: A Treatise on Baptism, second edition (London: Seeley, Burnside and Seeley, 1844)
